purpose: Application for inclusion of a name in the electoral roll as a new voter.
who_should_fill: An eligible Indian citizen applying for first-time inclusion at their ordinary place of residence.
documents_needed: Recent passport-size colour photograph
Self-attested age proof: birth certificate, Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence, Class X/XII certificate showing DOB, Indian passport, or other accepted proof
Self-attested residence proof: qualifying utility bill, Aadhaar, bank/post-office passbook, passport, land record, registered rent lease deed, registered sale deed, or other accepted proof
submit_to: ERO/AERO; may also be filed through the official voter services portal or handed to the relevant BLO.

purpose: Application for inclusion of an eligible overseas Indian elector in the electoral roll.
who_should_fill: An Indian citizen residing outside India who has not acquired citizenship of another country and meets the applicable age and ordinary-residence conditions tied to the Indian passport address.
documents_needed: Recent passport-size colour photograph
Copies of relevant Indian passport pages showing particulars and photograph
Copy of current valid visa endorsement (self-attested if sent by post)
Original passport for in-person verification
submit_to: ERO for the constituency covering the Indian address recorded in the passport; in person, by post, or through the official online service as applicable.

purpose: Letter for providing Aadhaar information for authentication of an elector entry in the electoral roll.
who_should_fill: A person already enrolled in an electoral roll who submits Aadhaar information or indicates they cannot furnish an Aadhaar number.
documents_needed: Aadhaar number, if furnished; or

If Aadhaar is unavailable, one listed alternative: MGNREGA job card, photo passbook, health insurance smart card, driving licence, PAN, NPR smart card, passport, pension document, specified service/official identity card, or UDID card
submit_to: Use the ECI voter services portal or election registration channel specified by ECI.

purpose: Application for objection to a proposed inclusion or deletion of a name from an existing electoral roll.
who_should_fill: An applicant raising an objection to a proposed inclusion, requesting deletion of an existing entry on a stated ground, or requesting deletion of their own name where applicable.
documents_needed: Applicant and concerned elector details, including EPIC number if available
Death certificate when death is the deletion ground (the form asks whether it is attached)
Supporting information relevant to the selected objection/deletion ground
submit_to: ERO for the relevant constituency; online filing is available through the official voter services portal.

purpose: Application for shifting residence, correction of entries, replacement EPIC, or marking a person with disability.
who_should_fill: An already registered elector requesting one of the services listed in Form 8.
documents_needed: For shifting: self-attested residence proof such as qualifying utility bill, Aadhaar, bank/post-office passbook, passport, land record, registered rent lease deed, or registered sale deed
For correction: self-attested documentary proof supporting the requested correction
For lost EPIC: copy of FIR/police report; for mutilated EPIC, return the old card
For PwD marking: disability details and certificate if available/required
submit_to: ERO for the relevant constituency, including through the official voter services portal.

purpose: ECI Citizen Service Portal describes Form 12C as a form for Kashmiri migrant electors who want to vote through postal ballot.
who_should_fill: Kashmiri migrant electors covered by the applicable postal-ballot arrangement; confirm current eligibility with the election authority.
documents_needed: Not verified: the Form 12C PDF was not among the uploaded files, so exact supporting documents are not asserted.
submit_to: Follow current instructions of the relevant election authority/Returning Officer; verify the process before submission.
